subject: Request: SAML session assertions + SCIM provisioning extracts (Cardinal Health)
messages:
From: Alice Hodges <alice.hodges@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cardinalhealth.com
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SAML session assertions + SCIM deltas for SOC2 audit

Hi Logan,

We are preparing for our SOC 2 readiness window and need a couple of artifact extracts from Redwood to satisfy our auditor. Can you provide the following for the Cardinal Health tenant?

1) SAML / IdP session assertions (CSV preferred) for the period 2025-06-01 through 2025-08-31. Required fields: AssertionID, NameID, sessionIndex, authnInstant, authnContext/ClassRef, sessionStart, sessionEnd, issuer, audience, and any assertion attributes that include role/group claims. We may redact NameIDs if needed but need a consistent mapping.

2) SCIM provisioning deltas for the same period (JSON Lines preferred). Include creates, updates, deletes with timestamps and actor (who/what performed the change).

3) An RBAC snapshot (CSV) of roles, role IDs, mapped permissions, and the attribute mapping that ties SCIM/claims to RBAC roles. If there is a mapping doc or script, please include.

4) Short statement of our account's retention settings for SAML session logs and provisioning events, including the log location and retention window.

We'd like artifacts delivered by close of business 2025-09-09 (Cardinal's auditor deadline). If anything requires a longer lead time or manual redaction, please call it out and provide an ETA.

Cardinal attached a short questionnaire with fields annotated — see attached: Cardinal_Security_Request_Sep2025.pdf

Thanks,
Alice Hodges
Sr. IT Security Analyst
Cardinal Health
security@cardinalhealth.com

---

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Request: SAML session assertions + SCIM deltas for SOC2 audit

Team — forwarding Cardinal's request. They want session assertions + SCIM deltas + RBAC snapshot for 2025-06-01 -> 2025-08-31. Deadline: 2025-09-09 COB.

Stephanie: can you extract the SAML assertion/session CSV and ensure authnContext and sessionIndex are included. We need to consider redaction of PII (NameID) — if redaction is necessary, provide a consistent pseudonym map and include a hash of original NameIDs for auditor verification.

Laura: can you pull SCIM deltas (creates/updates/deletes) with actor info and timestamps. Please include SCIM schema version and any custom attribute names used for role mapping.

Jonas: RBAC snapshot + mapping doc (how claims map to roles). Also include a short example of enforcement (policy lookup) and the current role->permission table.

Also we need an explicit retention statement (who/what stores these logs, retention window) and a safe transfer mechanism — Cardinal prefers a secure upload link. I added the Cardinal questionnaire to the attachments.

Please reply with an ETA by EOD 2025-09-03. If we need legal/PR clearance for any wording in the retention statement, loop them in.

Thanks — Logan
Director, Security & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
